system.description:
You raise your knee and slam your elbow, into an incoming attack catching it in between them. Make a melee taijutsu attack, comparing the result vs the attack result from the triggering creature. On a success, you are able to Interrupt and Dispel the triggering attack before it even hits you.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, the number of attacks this jutsu can apply to, increases by +1. When you increase the number of attacks this applies to, once cast, you can trigger this jutsu’s effect one additional time at no reaction cost before the beginning of your next turn.
